stance_basis: compiled historic structures list and reviewed archaeological studies without expressing opposition or support for the project
summary: The Buffalo Historical Society, under Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr., contributed to the Section 106 and 4(f) analysis by compiling a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment and reviewing past archaeological studies. Their work informed the EIS's findings that neither construction nor operation of the transit system should adversely impact any of the listed historic structures. The Society's contributions appear technical and informational rather than advocacy-oriented.
complaint_summary: The Buffalo Historical Society compiled a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment, which was incorporated into the Section 106 and 4(f) analysis of the EIS.
summary_quote: The Buffalo Historical Society (under the direction of Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr.) and the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier (represented by Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., Chairman) compiled a list of historic structures located along the proposed rail alignment.
